title: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to start StepFunctions execution on a schedule
description: Simple pattern that starts a StepFunctions execution every 5 minutes using Amazon EventBridge Scheduler and CDK.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An EventBridge Scheduler is created that start execution of StepFunctions workflow every 5 minutes using a cron expression.
Along with a schedule, the CDK stack creates the stepfunctions statemachine.
